title: Synthesising lead oxide and oxychloride minerals from spent lead acid battery waste using a choline-chloride based deep eutectic solvent
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00444F, Paper
Open Access

Enrico W. Manfredi-Haylock, Gwilherm K. Kerherve, David J. Payne
A 1 : 1 choline chloride–oxalic acid DES converted desulphurised LAB paste to lead oxalate. Residual Cl from solvent entrapment caused chloroxalate/oxychloride formation on calcination (300–500 °C). Cl-free solvents could reduce energy demand.
